image.caption: Cyberpunk 2077 - Create your own cyberpunk (CLEAN)
image.transformations: None. Byte-for-byte copy of the official full-resolution download; identical SHA-256 to the original.

reference_decode.transformations: Lossless PNG encode of the JPEG's decoded native pixels at 3024x1890. No rescale, crop, denoise, or sharpening. The JPEG remains the canonical still; this PNG is a convenience reference.
reference_decode.decoder_note: The JPEG is full-range yuvj444p with bt470bg color space; FFmpeg used the stream's own color metadata for the RGB24 decode. No color matrix override or range expansion was applied.

face_roi.note: The canonical still input is the whole native 3024x1890 image. This crop is not a replacement input and is not rescaled.

character.label: Male V (Cyberpunk 2077 player character)
character.evidence: Official screenshot filename 'Create_your_own_cyberpunk' and the in-game mirror interaction identify the player character; face, short hair, beard, facial cyberware, skin, collar, and jacket are clearly readable at native resolution.

transformations: Canonical still: no transformation. Byte-for-byte official 3024x1890 JPEG download; SHA-256 preserved.
Reference PNG: lossless encode of the JPEG's native decoded pixels at 3024x1890 RGB24; no rescale, crop, denoise, or sharpening. The JPEG remains canonical.
Face ROI: root-specified 960x960 crop at (1030,80) for display/analysis only; the whole native image remains the comparison input.
